items.question: What makes information Confidential Information under the Northbridge NDA?
items.answer:
The documents define "Confidential Information" under the Northbridge NDA as all information disclosed by one Party to the other in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential [1].

The definition also excludes information that becomes public through no breach of the Agreement, was known to the Recipient before disclosure, was independently developed without use of the Discloser's information, or was lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidence [1].
